_comment: Default keyword-to-action map shipped with Quill. User overrides are written to keywords.toml in the OS config dir and take precedence.

actions.START_LISTENING: Open the listening gate; begin capturing spoken input
actions.NEXT_ROW: Commit the current record to the workbook and start a new one
actions.DELETE_ROW: Discard the current in-progress record without writing it
actions.SEARCH_FOR: Filter the active sheet by the spoken criteria, e.g. 'search for black blouses under 50'
actions.CLEAR_SEARCH: Remove the search filters and return to where you were before searching
actions.SORT_TERMS: Answer the Needs-sorting list by voice: yes, a column name, same as ..., ignore
actions.UNDO: Take back the last sorting decision; say it again to keep stepping back
actions.END_NOTE: Close the note being dictated (Notes, Comments, Description ...); a note stays open across pauses until then, 'next row' or another column name
actions.APPEND_ON: Turn option: every turn adds to the same row (Append To)
actions.APPEND_OFF: Turn option: every turn is written to a new row (Next Row)
actions.ROWS_DOWN_ON: Turn option: the sheet's headings run down the first column (Rows Down)
actions.ROWS_DOWN_OFF: Turn option: the sheet's headings run across the first row (Columns Across)
